# peakhour_rp_waf_owasp_settings (Resource)

Manages reverse proxy WAF OWASP settings for a domain. The schema is represented as JSON.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "peakhour_rp_waf_owasp_settings" "example" {
  domain = "example.com"

  settings_json = jsonencode({
    methods = {
      allowed_methods = ["GET", "HEAD", "POST", "OPTIONS"]
    }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain name.

### Optional

- `settings_json` (String) OWASP settings as a JSON object. This is PATCHed to the API; omitted keys are left unchanged, and explicit nulls clear values. Server-side defaults are ignored for drift detection.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) WAF OWASP settings identifier (domain/rp_waf_owasp_settings).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import peakhour_rp_waf_owasp_settings.example example.com
```
